mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.description, r.school_id, r.is_builtin, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.is_builtin DESC, r.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId}
